mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 190 indicates elevated inflation that triggers expectations of monetary tightening, reducing S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 190.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in industrial production (INDPRO > 115) and declining unemployment (UNRATE < 5.5%) signal a robust economic cycle that increases corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 115 and UNRATE is below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, high housing starts (HOUST > 2100) indicate potential overbuilding and market saturation, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate a correction.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST exceeds 2100 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A GDPC1 value below 11000 billion dollars indicates weak economic growth, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 is below 11000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 350000) combined with moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 195) indicate resilient consumer spending without inflationary pressure, supporting positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 350000 and CPIAUCSL is below 195.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 115 (index 2017=100) indicates strong manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 115.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market with unemployment below 5.0% (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicates tight conditions that sustain consumer demand and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%.
